```{r}
#| label: references
#| results: asis
# The works the report cites, each only when what cites it is in it: SME
# (Luck et al.) always, and each cleaning method when a step in the
# provenance table used it, so the list names the methods that cleaned
# THESE data and no others. APA order, by first author. Non-ASCII letters
# are written as \u escapes, which R turns into the letter, so this file
# reads the same whatever encoding opens it.
steps <- unique(prov$step)
ica_methods <- if ("method" %in% names(prov)) {
  unique(na.omit(prov$method[prov$step == "AutoICA"]))
} else {
  character()
}
refs <- "Luck, S. J., Stewart, A. X., Simmons, A. M., & Rhemtulla, M. (2021). Standardized measurement error: A universal metric of data quality for averaged event-related potentials. *Psychophysiology*, *58*(6), e13793. https://doi.org/10.1111/psyp.13793"
# Blinks by condition, when the report has that section.
if (exists("blk")) {
  refs <- c(refs, "Zhang, G., Garrett, D. R., Simmons, A. M., Kiat, J. E., & Luck, S. J. (2024). Evaluating the effectiveness of artifact correction and rejection in event-related potential research. *Psychophysiology*, *61*(5), e14511. https://doi.org/10.1111/psyp.14511")
}
# Dependability, and what it is not for, when the per-trial measurements
# that section needs were read.
if (exists("meas") && !is.null(meas)) {
  refs <- c(refs,
    "Clayson, P. E., & Miller, G. A. (2017). ERP Reliability Analysis (ERA) Toolbox: An open-source toolbox for analyzing the reliability of event-related brain potentials. *International Journal of Psychophysiology*, *111*, 68–79. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijpsycho.2016.10.012",
    "Hedge, C., Powell, G., & Sumner, P. (2018). The reliability paradox: Why robust cognitive tasks do not produce reliable individual differences. *Behavior Research Methods*, *50*(3), 1166–1186. https://doi.org/10.3758/s13428-017-0935-1")
}
if ("EyeTracking" %in% steps) {
  refs <- c(refs, "Dimigen, O., Sommer, W., Hohlfeld, A., Jacobs, A. M., & Kliegl, R. (2011). Coregistration of eye movements and EEG in natural reading: Analyses and review. *Journal of Experimental Psychology: General*, *140*(4), 552\u2013572. https://doi.org/10.1037/a0023885")
}
if (any(c("AutoICA", "ICA") %in% steps)) {
  refs <- c(refs, "Pion-Tonachini, L., Kreutz-Delgado, K., & Makeig, S. (2019). ICLabel: An automated electroencephalographic independent component classifier, dataset, and website. *NeuroImage*, *198*, 181\u2013197. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2019.05.026")
}
if ("fastica" %in% ica_methods) {
  refs <- c(refs, "Hyv\u00e4rinen, A., & Oja, E. (2000). Independent component analysis: Algorithms and applications. *Neural Networks*, *13*(4\u20135), 411\u2013430. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0893-6080(00)00026-5")
}
if ("runica" %in% ica_methods) {
  refs <- c(refs, "Bell, A. J., & Sejnowski, T. J. (1995). An information-maximization approach to blind separation and blind deconvolution. *Neural Computation*, *7*(6), 1129\u20131159. https://doi.org/10.1162/neco.1995.7.6.1129")
}
if ("AutoGEDAI" %in% steps) {
  refs <- c(refs, "Ros, T., Ferat, V., Huang, Y., Colangelo, C., Kia, S. M., Wolfers, T., Vulliemoz, S., & Michela, A. (2025). Return of the GEDAI: Unsupervised EEG denoising based on leadfield filtering. *bioRxiv* (preprint, not yet peer reviewed). https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.10.04.680449")
}
if ("PREP" %in% steps) {
  refs <- c(refs, "Bigdely-Shamlo, N., Mullen, T., Kothe, C., Su, K.-M., & Robbins, K. A. (2015). The PREP pipeline: Standardized preprocessing for large-scale EEG analysis. *Frontiers in Neuroinformatics*, *9*, 16. https://doi.org/10.3389/fninf.2015.00016")
}
if ("ASR" %in% steps) {
  refs <- c(refs,
    "Mullen, T. R., Kothe, C. A. E., Chi, Y. M., Ojeda, A., Kerth, T., Makeig, S., Jung, T.-P., & Cauwenberghs, G. (2015). Real-time neuroimaging and cognitive monitoring using wearable dry EEG. *IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering*, *62*(11), 2553\u20132567. https://doi.org/10.1109/TBME.2015.2481482",
    "Chang, C.-Y., Hsu, S.-H., Pion-Tonachini, L., & Jung, T.-P. (2020). Evaluation of artifact subspace reconstruction for automatic artifact components removal in multi-channel EEG recordings. *IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering*, *67*(4), 1114\u20131121. https://doi.org/10.1109/TBME.2019.2930186")
}
if ("AutoReject" %in% steps) {
  refs <- c(refs, "Jas, M., Engemann, D. A., Bekhti, Y., Raimondo, F., & Gramfort, A. (2017). Autoreject: Automated artifact rejection for MEG and EEG data. *NeuroImage*, *159*, 417\u2013429. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2017.06.030")
}
cat(paste(sort(unique(refs), method = "radix"), collapse = "\n\n"), "\n")
```
